```json
"topology":"op-amp-less PTAT core (2:16 PNP, NMOS level-shift, PMOS mirror, long-L self-cascode devices) + fractional (Banba-like) bandgap output divider + weak-pullup start-up",
"rationale":"0.2 uA PTAT core (R1 sets I), mirrored 0.2 uA into R2+Q3 with resistive divider in parallel: Vref=Rb/(R2+Rd)*(Veb3+I*R2), giving ~0.66 V near-zero TC. Long-L self-cascode devices give the high VA needed for PSRR and line regulation. Total current is about 0.75 uA, roughly 1.35 uW. Deep-subthreshold wide PMOS (VSG ~0.7 V) and 2:16 PNPs keep the 1.6 V headroom. The start-up pulls pg low until ng rises."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Wp": (24.0, 6.0, 80.0),     # PMOS mirror bottom device W (self-cascode top = 3W, L/2)
    "Lp": (8.0, 2.0, 20.0),
    "Wn": (10.0, 3.0, 40.0),     # NMOS level-shift pair bottom device W
    "Ln": (8.0, 2.0, 20.0),
    "R1": (270e3, 120e3, 800e3), # PTAT resistor: I = UT ln8 / R1
    "R2": (3.0e6, 1.2e6, 8e6),   # PTAT gain resistor in Q3 branch
    "Rd": (8.0e6, 3e6, 20e6),    # total divider resistance (Ra+Rb)
    "kb": (0.735, 0.6, 0.85),    # Rb/Rd tap ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N1, N2 = 2, 16
    N = N2 / N1
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]
    Wpt, Lpt = 3 * Wp, max(0.15, Lp / 2)
    Wnt, Lnt = 3 * Wn, max(0.15, Ln / 2)
    R1, R2, Rd = p["R1"], p["R2"], p["Rd"]
    Rb = p["kb"] * Rd
    Ra = Rd - Rb

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror (self-cascode): M3 diode at pg, M4 feeds NMOS diode, M5 feeds output
    n.M("M3a", "p3", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M3b", "pg", "pg", "p3", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lpt)
    n.M("M4a", "p4", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4b", "ng", "pg", "p4", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lpt)
    n.M("M5a", "p5", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M5b", "vbg", "pg", "p5", "vdd", "pfet", Wpt, Lpt)
    # NMOS level-shift pair (self-cascode), M1 diode
    n.M("M1b", "ng", "ng", "n1", "vss", "nfet", Wnt, Lnt)
    n.M("M1a", "n1", "ng", "e1", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("M2b", "pg", "ng", "n2", "vss", "nfet", Wnt, Lnt)
    n.M("M2a", "n2", "ng", "e2", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=N1)
    n.R("R1", "e2", "eq2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eq2", m=N2)
    # fractional bandgap output
    n.R("R2", "vbg", "eq3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "eq3", m=1)
    n.R("Ra", "vbg", "vref", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    # start-up: weak pull-up on x, x pulls pg low until ng rises
    n.M("Mpu1", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu2", "s2", "vss", "s1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Mpu3", "x", "vss", "s2", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("Msd", "x", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    k_q = 8.617e-5
    T0 = 300.15
    Vg0, xti = 1.17, 3.0
    def veb(I, m, T):
        i_u = max(I / m, 1e-12)
        ut = k_q * T
        v0 = 0.76 + k_q * T0 * math.log(i_u / 10e-6)
        return Vg0 - (Vg0 - v0) * T / T0 - (xti - 1) * ut * math.log(T / T0)

    def outv(T):
        ut = k_q * T
        I = ut * math.log(N) / R1
        ie3 = 0.5 * I
        for _ in range(40):
            vb = veb(ie3, 1, T)
            vbg = (I * R2 + vb) * Rd / (R2 + Rd)
            ie3 = max(I - vbg / Rd, 1e-12)
        return vbg * Rb / Rd, I, vbg

    v27, I0, vbg0 = outv(T0)
    vs = [outv(t + 273.15)[0] for t in (-40, 0, 27, 70, 125)]
    tc = (max(vs) - min(vs)) / (v27 * 165) * 1e6

    i_su = 0.12e-6
    itot = 3 * I0 + i_su
    power = 1.8 * itot

    # supply sensitivity: dI/I ~ (0.67/VAn + 1.15/VAp), self-cascode boost ~4x
    VAn, VAp = 10.0 * Ln, 6.0 * Lp
    try:
        on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, 0.5, 0.3, 0.6)
        op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, 0.7, 0.3, 0.0)
        VAn = on["Id"] / max(on["gds"], 1e-18)
        VAp = op_["Id"] / max(op_["gds"], 1e-18)
    except Exception:
        pass
    boost = 4.0
    sens_I = (0.67 / (VAn * boost) + 1.15 / (VAp * boost))
    frac_ptat = I0 * R2 / (I0 * R2 + veb(I0 * 0.45, 1, T0))
    line = v27 * frac_ptat * sens_I
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(line, 1e-6))

    return n, {"vref": v27, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power,
               "line_reg": line, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
